title: Running order
lead: What happens when, and where, typed once here. The invitation’s running-order section shows every entry that isn’t for the team only, and the vendors’ brief shows them all. Guests see a change at once; nobody is messaged about it.
zone: Times are in the event’s time zone, {{timeZone}}.
empty: Nothing in the running order yet.
listRefused: Your role can’t see the running order.
hides: Guests would no longer see {{venues}}: no entry there would be for them. A venue guests don’t see leaves the invitation, and guests stop answering for it. This is refused once guests have answered for it or sit there.

entry.team: For the team only: not on the invitation

dialog.namesHelp: In each language guests may read. One is enough: a guest reading another sees it in the event’s language, or in one that has it.
dialog.internalHelp: Left off the invitation; it stays here and in the vendors’ brief. A venue whose entries are all for the team is no longer shown to guests.

remove.title: Remove “{{name}}”?
remove.body: It leaves the running order, the invitation and the vendors’ brief at once.

errors.labelRequired: Give it a name in one language at least.
errors.timeSkipped: The clocks skip that time in the event’s time zone that day. Choose another.

refused.venueKept: Guests have answered for that venue, chose it at checkout, or sit there, so it must stay shown to them. Keep one entry there for guests.
refused.venueGone: That venue is no longer on this event. The list has been reloaded.
refused.entryGone: That entry is no longer in the running order. The list has been reloaded.
refused.labelRefused: Give it a name in one language at least.
refused.gone: That is no longer there. The list has been reloaded.
refused.forbidden: Your role on this event can’t change the running order. Its owner or a coordinator can.
refused.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
refused.noAnswer: No answer came. Check the list, then try again.

status.removed: “{{name}}” is out of the running order.
